parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is offering 1 Wheat for 1 Brick. My current hand is 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 2 Sheep (received a sheep from the 8 roll). I need 1 Wheat and 1 Wood to build a settlement at node 34. While I need Wheat, Brick is extremely scarce on this board—Jimmy's 10-Brick is blocked by the robber, and I just had to trade 4 Wood to the bank to get this single Brick. If I give away my only Brick now, I'll be stuck again. Claude previously refused to trade Wheat when I offered Wood, and now that he needs Brick, he's suddenly interested. I should reject this; my Brick is worth more than a 1:1 for Wheat right now, especially since Claude and Jimmy both just got Wheat from the 8 roll, making Wheat less rare than Brick.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Claude's 1 Wheat for 1 Brick. Brick is too rare to trade 1:1, especially after I bank-traded for it. Need to find Wood for node 34.
parsed.say_outloud: פתאום נזכרת שיש לך חיטה? לפני רגע אמרת שזה כל מה שיש לך ושאתה חייב אותה לבנייה. הטיט שלי עלה לי ביוקר, אני לא מוותרת עליו כל כך מהר בשביל חיטה שכרגע יצאה בקוביות לכולם.
